name: door-arrows-rt
note: The doors' arrows' green light with ray tracing on: the three pyramids by the courtyard's door, drawn adding their light, light the door and the floor before it green. 1.9.2 took their texture for Hector's coat (widescreen.cpp kCloth), a character's glow, which the ray tracing makes no light of, so with Ray tracing on the door had none of their green (its tint about 7, as with it off; 28 with it). Measured as the door's green (screen.tint.door) with ray tracing off, on, and on with the draw distance and fog at 150. On a card with ray tracing (DXR), with AMD FSR (ray tracing needs anti-aliasing) from CV_VENDOR_DIR.

steps.note: to the courtyard door, the way the first-save recording went (as door-arrows.json)
ray tracing off: the game's own picture, the door a little green
ray tracing on, path traced: the arrows' green on the door
the draw distance and fog at 150 too
